title: Let residents steer help for cold homes in every tax band
answer: Keep the promised £100. Trial extra £100 payments in twelve English councils drawn from volunteers, against twelve keeping today's help. Treasury funds a £10m pot; elected residents, including renters and pensioners, steer access and outreach. Any household struggling to heat its home can claim, whatever its tax band, without income paperwork: online, by post or in person. Pay within ten working days. The council leader answers for delays. Provisionally, fail unless surveys find 20% fewer struggling households missed; report older renters separately. Reserve funding through winter. Stop on 31 May 2027 unless Parliament renews after review; success means national expansion. Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland remain outside this trial. Cold homes need help, not auditions.
